Contract:
Subagents are black boxes; emit one progress line per state transition so the operator sees the run. Every progress message uses exactly this one-line grammar; do not introduce alternate service-line prose or omit a field: `[] % | task= | phase= | stage=` Before task selection use `task=selection` and `phase=—`. Worker identity and conversation reuse are deliberately absent: progress is the durable ticket/phase transition, not the agent process. Stages: `⏳ resolving + planning` · `🔧 phase

(, ) executing` · `✅ phase

done → next` · `✅ all phases done → 🔍 audit` · `✅ audit PASS`. Retry path: `❌ audit FAIL → 🔄 re-run as fix` · `✅ re-run done → 🔍 audit R2`. Pause path (NOT a failure — awaiting the operator): `✋ PAUSED — `; the operator marks resolution in the Execution Log, then re-runs.
